verdict.rationale: DeepInfra is an inference cloud platform, and such a platform could plausibly offer user-defined event rules, triggers, or automations, so the story applies. The evidence documents no way for users to define rules that fire actions on events. Automatic forwarding of deprecated models and autoscaling are built-in platform behaviors, not user-defined rules, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
